implementation: Added a pure NumPy expert-fusion core for aligned tensors shaped experts, frames, height, width.
Probability inputs are converted to logits before model-specific temperature scaling and sigmoid fusion.
Base weights are normalized and entropy confidence produces per-frame dynamic weights that are retained in the report.
Added minimum-expert support, deterministic spatial top-k selection, and an inclusive threshold alternative.
Added memory-mapped tensor experts and command experts that validate/rasterize normalized boxes or polygons into probability grids.
Added pixel-budgeted dynamic batching and incremental lossless mask-video writing.
Extended SAM 3.1 direct segmentation with an optional probability-support tensor derived from public binary masks and per-object probabilities; it does not claim internal pixel logits.
Added an opt-in AIMLAPI adapter for frame batches and three example native-multimodal experts: xiaomi/mimo-v2.5, google/gemini-3-8-flash, and bytedance/dola-seed-2-0-pro.
Reformatted README as the entry point for the generic VOID+Model toolkit and updated architecture, instructions, and contribution contracts.

non_claims: No AIMLAPI request was sent and no AIMLAPI key was present.
No SAM 3.1 checkpoint or CUDA inference was run.
No Netflix VOID, CogVideoX, or expert-panel quality metric was run.
The local ensemble fixture uses synthetic tensors and real ffmpeg encoding; it is not final experiment evidence.
SAM 3.1's public response does not expose internal pixel logits; --scores-output is explicitly object-probability support over binary masks.
Dynamic entropy weighting is implemented and exercised numerically, but it is not calibrated against real interaction cases.
